interpretation: Eight compiled does not mean eight faithful. These qualitative judgments do not define a held-out accuracy score.

cases.text: Sunny day turns dark due to dust storm.
cases.note: The transition and dust-storm cause are present, but sunny is an ordinary day property rather than an explicitly earlier state. The dynamic reading needs review.

cases.text: Lady on the screen is criticizing exiled Mexicans for not standing up to the Narco State.
cases.note: The criticism reason is partly kept as a phrase, but the program separately asserts a negative stand event in world scope. This is not a faithful criticism-content translation.

cases.text: Man giving a speech is using a microphone.
cases.note: The speak and use events share the same man, and the microphone is attached to use. This satisfies the specified basic role/identity reading; full lexical equivalence is not certified.
Cannon/explosives remains one opaque phrase. The program retains blasting/background but does not resolve the noun-phrase alternatives.
FOX News is compiled as an existing broadcast-program referent. The fragment alone does not identify whether the intended claim is about a logo, written label or organization.

cases.text: Multiple aerial clips of the smoke coming from the bottom of the building.
cases.note: Clip/topic, aerial, smoke and building-bottom relations survive, but the coming-smoke event is in world scope rather than clearly inside depiction. Multiple is not a defined group quantifier.

cases.text: Power outages likely in residential area.
cases.note: Both baselines refuse the likely-outages description; no actual outage is asserted. Modality remains unsupported.

cases.text: Made landfall on the east coast of Mexico with winds at 45mph.
cases.note: Both baselines refuse this fragment with a speed measurement and omitted subject. The numeric guard is broader than counting; it also declines this scalar measurement.

cases.text: Evening of the third shows values at 2.5.
cases.note: Date, ordinal and numeric value appear in the graph, but what is being measured and what shows the value are unspecified. The original context is needed.
The visible label/handle is turned into a person referent. The fragment lacks the context needed to decide the intended OCR/profile assertion.
